capabilities: Find near-duplicate tags by case, plural, separator and spelling rules
Detect synonyms and abbreviations with an optional AI pass
Review each group and choose which tag to keep
Merge tags in note bodies and frontmatter across the vault
disambiguation: Not an AI-only tool: duplicate detection runs on local rules, and the AI pass is optional.
extras: Without the AI pass the plugin makes no network requests; the AI pass sends only tag names, never note content, titles or file paths. Installation is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugin folder.
problem: Vaults collect near-duplicate tags such as #idea and #ideas or #to-do and #todo, and there is no built-in way to find and merge them across all notes.

relations.evidence: Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama or any endpoint that speaks the chat completions format.
